statement:
∀ red : Reduction.loc p →+* ZMod p,
  (∀ (a d : ℤ), ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ d → ∀ r : Reduction.loc p,
    (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / (d : ℚ) → red r * (d : ZMod p) = (a : ZMod p)) →
  ∀ (r : Reduction.loc p) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    ModN.mkQ p (r • u) = red r • ModN.mkQ p u
proof:
intro red hred r u
obtain ⟨a,d,hd,he⟩ := (h_T004.1.1 r.val).mp r.property
have hd0 : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
  exact_mod_cast (show d ≠ 0 from fun hz => hd (hz ▸ dvd_zero _))
have hr : (d : Reduction.loc p) * r = (a : Reduction.loc p) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (d : ℚ) * (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ)
  rw [he, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hd0]
apply (@yui_aux_0002 p l K fieldK V addV modV act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_T004 d hd)
dsimp only
rw [smul_smul, mul_comm (d : ZMod p), hred a d hd r he]
calc
  (d : ZMod p) • ModN.mkQ p (r • u) =
      ModN.mkQ p ((d : Reduction.loc p) • (r • u)) := by
        exact (@yui_aux_0003 p l K fieldK V addV modV act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_T004 d (r • u)).symm
  _ = ModN.mkQ p ((a : Reduction.loc p) • u) := by
    congr 1
    rw [smul_smul, hr]
  _ = (a : ZMod p) • ModN.mkQ p u :=
    @yui_aux_0003 p l K fieldK V addV modV act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_T004 a u

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type u_2) [fieldK : Field K] (V : Type u_1) [addV : AddCommGroup V]
  [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (act : ↥Reduction.SL →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ End ℂ V) (x y h : ↥Reduction.SL) (v0 : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p →
    CharP K p →
      0 ≤ l ∧ l < ↑p →
        Reduction.localizationFacts p l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 M →
          ∀ (red : ↥(Reduction.loc p) →+* ZMod p),
            (∀ (a d : ℤ), ¬↑p ∣ d → ∀ (r : ↥(Reduction.loc p)), ↑r = ↑a / ↑d → red r * ↑d = ↑a) →
              ∀ (r : ↥(Reduction.loc p)) (u : Reduction.MR p M), (ModN.mkQ p) (r • u) = red r • (ModN.mkQ p) u
